name: ui_dispatch_to_app
comment: (res, page, ev): app layers -> page handler -> active pane -> page_menu_key/page_pane_nav (Ghidra truncates at 84 bytes; real end 30093c1c)

name: page_init
comment: page_init(obj, id): clear rects, apply layout, send 2000 (0x7d0) to page handler

name: page_show
comment: page_show(page, surface): layout, 0x7dc page, 0x7d9 panes, flush, 0x7dd, 0x7da, 0x7d7 focused

name: page_broadcast
comment: page_broadcast(page, ev, mask): 4=app layers, 2=page handler, 1=all panes

name: page_apply_layout
comment: computes pane rects from current layout (special cases map/trip)

name: layout_grid_rects
comment: pane rects from {n,sizes} in half-row units (2 cols x 44 px rows)

name: layout_rows3_rects
comment: pane rects as full-width rows of 220/3 px

name: page_change_layout
comment: handler for 0xfae / 0x232b: set layout, 0x7d6 to panes, post 0xfa2

name: page_set_focus
comment: page_set_focus(page, state 0/1/2, pane): sends 0x7d7 to focusable pane

name: page_pane_focusable
comment: pane can take focus in current state

name: page_focus_cursor
comment: update focus cursor x/y (00053b50/00053b54) from focused pane rect

name: page_menu_key
comment: state-0 key handler: MENU (0x3ef) opens page_desc[id].menu

name: page_pane_nav
comment: state-1/2 key handler: rocker moves pane focus, MENU, ENTER=choose field, BACK=leave

name: page_desc_index
comment: index of id in page_desc[40] or -1

name: page_order_index
comment: index of id in page_order[13] or -1

name: page_next
comment: PAGE key: next enabled page in page_order, posts {0xfa1,id}

name: page_prev
comment: BACK key fallback: pop page history or previous enabled page

name: ui_global_keys
comment: last key stage: 0x3f0 PAGE, 0x3f2 BACK, 0x3f3 MARK, 0x3f4 FIND, results 0xfa0/0xfac/0x13ad/0x213d

name: ui_page_commands
comment: results 0xfa1 set page, 0xfa9/0xfaa info fields, 0xfab/0xfac focus, 0xfae layout, 0xfaf pane class

name: ui_periodic
comment: event 2: backlight timeout, broadcast {2}, broadcast {1} when data flag 000432a8 set

name: pane_classes_init
comment: fills pane class defs {handler, selectable, needs_baro, long, short}

name: ui_set_flow_mode
comment: ui_set_flow_mode(mode, page, flag): clears/pushes page history

name: page_menu_index
comment: index of page id in the Pages menu item table 00171170 (13 entries)

name: page_order_dlg_init
comment: Page Order dialog init (counts cyclable pages)

name: page_order_dlg_event
comment: Page Order dialog: ENTER toggles enable bit, arrows reorder page_order, BACK closes

name: page_order_dlg_draw
comment: Page Order dialog draw (body split into 301332d4)

name: map_key
comment: map pane key handler (zoom 0x3ed/0x3ee, BACK, ENTER)

name: map_zoom_step
comment: map_zoom_step(map, dir): zoom level byte map+0x18, 1..18

name: pane_map
comment: pane class 92: map pane of page 1

name: page_cycle_pos
comment: index into page_order of current cycle position

name: page_desc
comment: [40] x 24: id, cyclable u8, enabled bit0, default enabled, menu*, handler

name: page_layouts
comment: [40] x 24: id, layouts**, n_layouts, n_modes, default idx[2]*, current idx[2]*

name: page_panes
comment: [40] x 20: id, default classes m0/m1, current classes m0/m1

name: pane_class_defs
comment: [161] x 16: handler, u8 selectable, u8 needs_baro, long name, short name

name: flush_main
comment: set by result 0x7d4: blit main_surface after dispatch

name: flush_surface
comment: surface to blit after dispatch when overlay open

name: pages_menu_items
comment: 13 x 16 {name, 4000, page id, 0}: Satellites, Map, Compass, ...
